name: claude-mods

plugins.name: ascii-tree
plugins.description: Styles ASCII trees (heavy ┣━━/┗━━ and light ├──/└── in a ``` block) in Claude's replies on the terminal in a "lineage" palette: every guide in the color of the parent that owns it (brown root, then warm tan → clay → rosewood → stone by depth), green reserved for leaves and leaf tips, paths, commands, numbers, quotes and key: value leaves highlighted, children aligned, and wrapping that keeps each row under its own branch with guides unbroken. Explicit line breaks inside a node (a line of only │/┃ guides then text) draw as that node's own continuation lines, aligned at its label and styled like it.

description: Claude Code mods: ascii-tree styles the ASCII trees in Claude's replies.
